verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say the Postman CLI checks API specifications against configured API governance rules (postman-docs-22), and the release notes add that it can lint API schemas and run security and governance checks (postman-docs-32). Spec Hub provides the spec-design surface where those specs live (postman-docs-16). The core capability is clearly first-party, but the evidence consists of short summary lines only. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how style/governance rulesets are configured or customized (rule authoring, severity, rule formats), evidence of in-editor linting within Spec Hub, independent or hands-on corroboration.
